input.title: [Mobile] Underline, Strikethrough, Text Color and Background Highlight are not carried when copying thought
input.body:
```
- One 
- Two 
- Three 
- Four
```

## Step to Reproduce
1. Add Underline to One
2. Add Strikethrough to Two
3. Add any Text Color to Three
4. Add any Background Highlight to Four
5. Select all
6. Create a subthought to avoid Issue #3622
7. Paste


## Current behavior
Text formatting and color are not carried over to the pasted text
This also happens when single copying each of the thought. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a950fc40-d653-4b39-9643-ec021f153e59


## Expected behavior
Text formatting and color should be carried over when copying thought.
Refer to the copying  Bold and Italic text #3959
